q: Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?
banner_text: Mendel, Sanger and Palade found 98 records

Researcher

Changes in this gene cause about 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers.⁠23 I found 4 conditions related to BRCA1.⁠1–4

BRCA1 makes a protein that helps keep genetic information stable and acts as a tumor suppressor.⁠23
